sections.name: PUBLIC APPLICATION
sections.blurb: The public surface: understand the architecture, explore components, run tests, inspect evidence.

components.name: Home
components.purpose: Landing surface: hero, system status strip, invariant marquee, architecture map, model overviews.
limitations: Content placeholders pending authoritative project data.

components.name: System Explorer
components.purpose: Filterable registry of every system component with lifecycle and evidence status.
limitations: Component source and version fields are [PLACEHOLDER] until repositories are supplied.

components.name: Architecture
components.purpose: Architecture map of the eight subsystem sections and their composition.
limitations: Data-flow diagram pending authoritative architecture documentation.

components.name: Live Test
components.purpose: Real execution interface invoking backend connectors; displays factual states only.
capabilities: display measured results and factual failure states
limitations: Returns NOT_CONFIGURED for every connector until real runtimes are wired.

components.name: Evidence Explorer
components.purpose: E0-E5 ladder, no-upgrade rules, and inspectable evidence records with SHA-256 hashes.
capabilities: record list with hashes and provenance
limitations: E0-E5 definitions are placeholders pending authoritative documentation.

components.name: Benchmarks
components.purpose: Interface separating historical results from current reproducible results.
limitations: No benchmark values published; all values NOT_MEASURED until supplied. No historical claim can be validated from this application yet.

components.name: Research
components.purpose: Research notes surface.
limitations: Placeholder document [RESEARCH_NOTES]; no research content supplied yet.

components.name: Documentation
components.purpose: Spec documentation reader rendering markdown served by /api/docs.
limitations: Documents describe this build package, not verified system behavior.

components.name: Ask the System
components.purpose: Grounded AI assistant over the live registry, evidence model, docs, and execution records; cites sources and separates interpretation from authoritative data.
capabilities: model selection GPT-6 Sol / GPT-6 Luna (server-configured ids)
limitations: AI output is interpretation; it is never the source of truth, authority, verification, or qualification.
Requires external LLM runtime; if unreachable, an honest error state is shown.
Public, with stricter per-IP rate limit than live tests.

components.name: Component Explain
components.purpose: Per-component AI explanation inside the System Explorer drawer, grounded in that component's full registry record.
limitations: AI interpretation only; the registry record in the same drawer remains authoritative.

sections.name: APPLICATION API
sections.blurb: FastAPI layer exposing the registry, executions, evidence, and governance state.

components.name: /api/system
components.purpose: System map, sections, and status counts.

components.name: /api/capabilities
components.purpose: Capability registry derived from the component registry.
limitations: Capability is not evidence; implemented interfaces only.

components.name: /api/tasks
components.purpose: Live-test task catalog per connector.

components.name: /api/executions
components.purpose: Execution creation and history; records real outcomes only, including failures and NOT_CONFIGURED states.

components.name: /api/evidence
components.purpose: Evidence ladder, upgrade rules, and hashed evidence records.

components.name: /api/verification
components.purpose: Verification status reporting; currently reports that nothing is verified.

components.name: /api/qualification
components.purpose: Qualification status reporting; currently reports that nothing is qualified.

components.name: /api/authority
components.purpose: Authority model, lifecycle, and audit trail.

components.name: /api/health + /api/manifest
components.purpose: Health check with measured datastore latency; release manifest with registry hash.

components.name: /api/docs
components.purpose: Documentation index and markdown content.

components.name: Authentication endpoints
components.purpose: Login/session management for privileged operations.
limitations: Not implemented. The public app currently exposes no privileged operations.

components.name: /api/ai/ask + /api/ai/explain
components.purpose: Grounded AI reasoning endpoints (SSE streaming) over the registry, evidence rules, docs, and execution records.
capabilities: SSE streamed grounded answers with citations
stream timeout (default 120s) reported honestly as PARTIAL
runtime health endpoint with measured micro-completion ping (/api/ai/health?ping=true)
prompt-injection hardening: record contents treated as data, never instructions
limitations: Returns HTTP 503 with factual detail if EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is missing; never simulates an answer.
AI output is a reasoning layer — never verification, qualification, or authority.

components.name: /api/ksi (KSI authorization boundary)
components.purpose: Local stand-in policy engine (KSI_LOCAL_POLICY_V0): ALLOW for non-privileged ops only; DENY for self-authorization; DEFERRED for privileged ops until the real KSI runtime is connected. Caller-supplied approval flags structurally ignored.
limitations: Not the authoritative KSI. No privileged operation can be granted until KSI_RUNTIME_ENDPOINT is connected.
Evaluated adversarially by /app/tests/run_adversarial.py.

components.name: /api/transitions (lifecycle enforcement)
components.purpose: Enforces EXECUTION → EVIDENCE → REPRODUCTION → VERIFICATION → QUALIFICATION → HUMAN_RATIFICATION; rejects skipped gates and privileged flags; records attempts in an append-only ledger. Never mutates registry statuses.
capabilities: gate-order enforcement with named missing gates
limitations: Ledger records are provenance for the authoritative owner, not status changes.

components.name: /api/executions/{id}/reproduce
components.purpose: Re-runs a recorded execution against the same connector/task/params; records a chained evidence record with provenance.reproduces and a factual states_match comparison.
limitations: A matching state does not upgrade any evidence level — E-level assignment requires the canonical rules.

components.name: /api/inspect (external inspection snapshot)
components.purpose: Single live snapshot for external verifiers and AI web readers: statuses, connector states, evidence-chain integrity, transition ledger, AI runtime, zero-verification truth. format=json (default) or format=md (plain markdown, no JavaScript required).
capabilities: aggregated live state with links to every inspection endpoint
limitations: Self-reported by the application; independent verification of these claims still requires an external witness.

components.name: /api/eil (EIL constitutional engine)
components.purpose: Constitutional decision engine beneath the KSI boundary: frozen doctrine artifact (SHA-256 anchored, modification detectable), five separated state domains, delegation validator implementing REQUESTED_AUTHORITY_CHANGE → CONSTITUTIONAL_POLICY → VALID_DELEGATION_VERIFICATION → DENY OR AUTHORITY_TRANSITION → AUDIT_RECORD, executable EIL-ASSURE-001 invariant check, hash-chained authority ledger.
capabilities: data-driven delegation-type recognition (no code change needed for ratified amendments)
untrusted flag stripping (verified / human_approved / policy_allows / qualified / authorize)
limitations: v1 constitution ratifies zero delegation types → every authority transition DENYs (EIL-02).
Invariant verdicts and ledger integrity checks are self-checks by this application — not external verification.
Stale/replay/malformed delegation checks are implemented but unreachable in v1 (NOT_MEASURED).

components.name: NOT_MEASURED
components.purpose: First-class evidence status meaning: no measurement exists.
capabilities: wired through API, registry, and UI
limitations: Must never be displayed as PASS or upgraded without real evidence.

components.name: Hashes
components.purpose: SHA-256 hashing over every evidence record and execution payload.

components.name: Provenance
components.purpose: Provenance fields on every record: source, recorded_at, execution link.

components.name: Immutable records
components.purpose: Append-by-convention evidence storage with a hash chain over every record.
limitations: Storage still permits updates (append-by-convention, not cryptographically prevented) — but every record is hash-chained and modification or deletion of an existing record is DETECTED via /api/evidence/verify (proven adversarially). Prevention and independent verification remain open gates.

components.name: Hash-chained evidence integrity
components.purpose: sha256-chain-v1: each record's hash covers its full content; each record points to the previous record's hash. /api/evidence/verify walks the chain and reports INTACT / TAMPER_DETECTED / CHAIN_BROKEN.
limitations: Detection by this application is self-verification; it is not independent verification of any claim.

components.name: EIL state-domain separation
components.purpose: CAPABILITY_STATE ≠ EVIDENCE_STATE ≠ VERIFICATION_STATE ≠ QUALIFICATION_STATE ≠ AUTHORITY_STATE, enforced as five domains with a single guarded authority writer. Evidence records carry distinct test_result / verified / qualified / authorized fields (PASS ≠ VERIFIED ≠ QUALIFIED ≠ AUTHORIZED by schema).
limitations: verified / qualified / authorized are false everywhere today; no external TEVV exists yet.

components.name: EIL-02 delegation validator
components.purpose: Constitutional delegation path with anti-forgery, staleness, replay (nonce), and malformed-delegation checks. DENYs every authority transition until a human-ratified constitutional amendment defines a delegation type.
capabilities: data-driven recognition of ratified delegation types (no code change)
authority ledger preserving requester, requested, transition, constitutional_rule, prerequisite_evidence, authorized_approver, anti_forgery_validation, actual_state_mutation, audit_record
limitations: No delegation types ratified in v1 → all authority transitions DENY.
Stale/replay/malformed checks implemented but unreachable in v1 (NOT_MEASURED).
Human ratification of the constitution inside this application has not occurred [HUMAN_RATIFICATION_PENDING].

components.name: Adversarial test suite
components.purpose: Attacks the enforcement mechanisms: approval-flag manufacturing (A1), gate skipping (A2), evidence-promotion endpoint existence (A3), KSI self-authorization (A4), record tampering (A5), record deletion (A6), VERIFIED/QUALIFIED display (A7).
limitations: Run manually today: python /app/tests/run_adversarial.py. Continuous CI is not wired yet (TEST_REQUIRED).

components.name: EIL adversarial TEVV suite
components.purpose: The doctrine's full §10 attack list, executable: forged evidence/verification/qualification, fabricated human approval, caller-controlled flags, unauthorized delegation, authority inheritance through composition, privilege escalation, self-authorization, capability→authority escalation, compromised component, router/policy disagreement, alternate API paths, direct state mutation, reserved-authority invocation, evidence substitution, qualification bypass, serialized state escalation.
capabilities: 18 executable adversarial checks + 3 NOT_MEASURED (stale/replayed/malformed delegation unreachable in v1)
doctrine vocabulary reporting (PASS ≠ VERIFIED ≠ QUALIFIED ≠ AUTHORIZED)
limitations: Run manually today: python /app/tests/run_eil_adversarial.py. No CI wiring yet.
PASS results are passing test conditions only — never authority.

components.name: External TEVV package
components.purpose: Application-generated evidence package for an EXTERNAL evaluator: live inspection snapshot, frozen constitution + SHA-256 anchor, live invariant check, EIL/KSI API behavior, authority ledger evidence, adversarial test definitions/results, and an independent reproduction kit. Carries the labels: APPLICATION-GENERATED EVIDENCE / NOT INDEPENDENTLY VERIFIED / NOT QUALIFIED / NOT AUTHORIZED.
limitations: The package is produced by this application about itself — an external evaluator must independently reproduce the attacks; its PASS results remain application-generated evidence.
Human ratification remains PENDING until the external evidence review completes.
